result.markdown:
For a small support team, my top recommendation is **Freshdesk**\. It offers a good balance of affordability, ease of use, ticket management and automation.

However, there are five products worth considering, depending on how your team works.

## Best help desk software compared (2026)

![Freshdesk Logo PNG Vector, Icon Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qU8kcZ34jjxaMCtOBf7YWhzyOSb4fLSOT_GPJYQYIx24a7PwWoi7hpZo4x509_4b3-kIDLNQe_ItQQEi-WAvlGt3qon3gqgkkzkVJ7rlKkd7YLr912Nq6y7Vk1Uu5WARnpY3GOispDCTHWQEF5GWM56LXxTfHKwJYwpAR5GCS7-znnYRHScTTJZc1y6rm-b?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Freshdesk**

(Best overall)

From \$19 per agent/month, annual billing.

- Excellent ticket management
- Automation and SLA management
- Knowledge base and self-service
- Good for growing support teams

Best for teams wanting a proper help desk without enterprise complexity.

[Freshdesk website](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/)

---

![Help Scout Pricing & Reviews 2026 | Techjockey.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Vc4OfpksDG0SYFQO2E4DBpLJOQUw-u5-79PbQ0FAzOhtZzreG-oym8CqN3NjPdhGdB9thM6s19ul7-oCFNRzT3e41X5EcsNhFO6CSeSVnQFxwuN5lbEVYZwGfBuSEovHpvvj_dafp0K7DuHOnDsBXe2D-P9xjZT98_6jjWq8rmebpqXoOtAcpGFSu_5ylm1p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Help Scout**

(Best for small teams)

Free for up to 5 users; paid from \$25/user/month annually.

- Very intuitive interface
- Shared inbox
- Customer conversation history
- Knowledge base and collaboration

Best for teams handling mostly email enquiries.

[Help Scout website](https://www.helpscout.com/)

---

![Planning your knowledge base](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c-aP08cOYxkyyv9X77vAO6BTznUrnbcE682O_PNXv85rTzeJ7P8rfPi0zwEy5RuJoItPtTqoOS_qx_th3WBRO5qW1_R1PEH6lnQv9fjQNK8k9Lq0ZpXaKAQ9c430TCrqKQIQ-l-YOuE_UJtZkcQj3vAw0fnqYwhILulvnKb-85lypWsGsBgNPmp7t1d2mt9a?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho Desk**

(Best budget option)

Free for up to 3 users; paid plans from \$7/user/month annually.

- Strong ticket management
- Automation and workflows
- Customer portals
- Excellent Zoho ecosystem integration

Best for smaller businesses wanting to keep costs down.

[Zoho Desk website](https://www.zoho.com/desk/)

---

![CXPA Global | CX Day](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Df7ZME9U6OBHF5y7Iy8re15rfxWfkij2J5upWOY6h17xPwPTHy9GzGMO1pjPycv2eahYGXuZJQqpk7Eu-n45330bnP145JuZvq23mLa9ySgQfmrjrLanGhUx6oyklDReusakKYD0C0EVNYz4WHwYHTEn8t4EiNn2pI71GHk_6Pu88F0xspYAogvoagE-Nhjq?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zendesk**

Suite plans from approximately \$55/agent/month annually.

- Powerful ticketing and routing
- Advanced reporting
- Extensive integrations
- Multichannel customer support

Best if you expect significant growth or more complex support requirements.

[Zendesk website](https://www.zendesk.com/)

---

![Intercom Logo PNG Vector (SVG) Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/bPosq0miqOxn9psHP0sccURRASv80U-UNoWLX8Q-wcZG39r0iQ21-Q3Xktlp76mQXf247Q8g03cKUaA7OXALBjOZrNpYaEcDyXN0L2b_YZZyhWhtUZBEzGyXZmA08RhujFDWpAZXvgCdPwYeDYHXk9IRUOfG7KzV8RcHwlaFUuefM-5HVY5XeK4FYtR3jtl4?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Intercom**

From \$29/seat/month annually, plus AI resolution costs.

- Excellent live chat
- AI-powered support
- Automated customer conversations
- In-app messaging

Best for SaaS businesses and teams prioritising live chat and AI.

[Intercom website](https://www.intercom.com/)

Prices are indicative USD list prices and vary by billing arrangement, plan and additional features. ## My recommendation

| Your priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Best all-round help desk | Freshdesk |
| Easiest to use | Help Scout |
| Lowest cost | Zoho Desk |
| Advanced reporting and workflows | Zendesk |
| AI and live chat | Intercom |


For most teams with around 3–10 support agents, I'd shortlist Freshdesk and Help Scout first.
